series: Company-news bridge — material wire events routed into covered subjects' research pools
notes: THE SUBJECTS ARRAY IS THE ENABLED SET — the sweep re-reads it every tick, so covering another name is a one-line edit here (no redeploy). Per-subject score floors live in bridge_config.json beside this file. Deliberately NOT under .claude/connectors/: that namespace belongs to feeds scripts/run_connectors.py fetches, and this sweep runs inside the cockpit (ui/server/src/bridge-scheduler.ts, BRIDGE_MODE=batch). Registering it there would put a row in the Data Library that the connector runner never runs — permanently 'needs attention', polluting the feed-health counts and pointing the auto-repair PR loop at a fetcher that is fine. Observability lives at GET /api/bridge/status instead.
